acceptance_signals: The Markdown guide clearly owns interview delivery: timed talk tracks, cut points, role branches, likely questions, demo transitions, and evidence navigation rather than repeating the standalone story verbatim.
The English and Simplified Chinese HTML guides expose equivalent whole-project interview routes in natural language and link to their matching-language standalone project story.

A default approximately two-minute route has explicit safe stopping points, and a five-to-seven-minute screen-share route names when to open the stable refund demo, artifact replay deep dive, and evidence portfolio.
Role branches cover at least software or AI engineering, platform or infrastructure, and product or technical product audiences without inventing new project outcomes.

Likely questions address why the project is more than a linter, how advisory and deterministic checks differ, why product drift remains a human judgment, what the strongest engineering evidence is, and what would be built next.
Decision-attribution language remains consistent with the confirmed Airbnb and artifact-replay list and does not present Agent-proposed low-level repairs as solely human-invented architecture.
Stable 0.2.1 capability remains distinct from 0.3.0rc1 and development-source journeys; unsupported adoption, security, portability, repeated-reliability, and interview-success claims remain absent.
The existing focused artifact replay story remains a technical follow-up rather than replacing the whole-project narrative.
All guide pages keep local assets only, restrictive CSP, semantic HTML, visible keyboard focus, working repository-relative links, and responsive behavior without new client-side state.
Focused interview-documentation and product-site tests, task and repository governance, exact scope validation, task JSON parsing, and git diff checks pass.

All pre-existing changed content is preserved outside the exact included paths; pre-existing files under broad task and baseline prefixes are preservation-only, and existing STATUS, test, and dated-log content is preserved except for bounded Slice 2 updates.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-89b0b53c0da348be8ddd4bef31dfcebe and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control.

requirement.summary: Revise the existing English and Simplified Chinese Interview Guide surfaces so they operationalize the admitted whole-project story for interviews without duplicating the standalone public pages. Add a compact two-minute default route with explicit cut points, a five-to-seven-minute screen-share expansion, role-specific branches, likely follow-up questions, and clear navigation among the whole-project story, stable refund demo, artifact-replay deep dive, and evidence portfolio. Preserve the distinction between stable release and development-source capability, human product judgment and mechanical task checks, and human-originated, joint, and Agent-proposed decisions.

items: The guide could duplicate the standalone story and recreate the evidence-dashboard problem identified in prior feedback.
Adding multiple role branches could make the default route too dense or blur the single central narrative.
Bilingual guide variants could drift in structure, claim strength, or navigation.
Decision-attribution wording could overstate individual authorship or understate the Agent's design contribution.
Stable and development-source behavior could be mixed into one release claim.
Existing Interview Guide content includes useful commands and evidence routes that must be preserved or deliberately integrated.
tests/test_interview_documentation.py, STATUS.md, and the dated log already contain Slice 1 and pre-existing work that must be preserved.
Broad governance task and baseline prefixes contain pre-existing work that must remain byte-identical except for the new Slice 2 task and baseline.

Reviewed assumption: The standalone public pages created in Slice 1 are complete enough to serve as the concise visual story surface.
Reviewed assumption: The current Guide visual system and local assets are sufficient; no generated imagery, JavaScript application state, or framework migration is needed.
